groups.name: Constant crashes and broken functionality
groups.description: Reviewers report crashes, freezing, loading or login failures, and broken features after updates that make the app unreliable or unusable.
groups.quote: Gets worse with every single update & is now completely unusable

groups.name: Updates cause crashes and invoice failures
groups.description: Reviewers say recent updates have made the app slow and unstable, causing freezing or crashes and preventing invoices from loading or sending.
groups.quote: This app was seamless before whatever update has been given. Now takes an age to load crashes constantly while trying to send invoices.

groups.name: Frequent crashes and freezing
groups.description: Reviewers say the app has become buggy and unstable, often freezing or crashing and preventing them from invoicing or completing other work.
groups.quote: New update on this app is now unusable. unable to raise invoices on phone, as app just crashes

groups.name: Account and payment problems with poor support
groups.description: Reviewers say blocked accounts, withheld or failed payments, and broken billing features disrupted their businesses, while customer support provided little or no effective help.
groups.quote: Could not process a clients payment and their service is terrible ! No phone line just messaging people that will eventually just cancel your subscription because they feel like your not worth the headache terrible.

groups.name: App is limited and unreliable
groups.description: Reviewers find the app confusing, buggy, slow, or lacking essential functionality, making it difficult to accomplish what they need.
groups.quote: Can’t do much on the app at all. Not very useful.

groups.name: Rising fees and payment frustrations
groups.description: Reviewers object to rising prices, unexpected charges, high payment-collection fees, and pressure to use built-in payment processing.
groups.quote: When I first started using this app everything was free, then they added abt a $12 charge for basically nothing, now charging to make and send invoices?

groups.name: Mobile app fails at basic invoicing tasks
groups.description: Reviewers report that the mobile app cannot reliably perform essential tasks such as viewing, creating, editing, sending, and managing invoices or receipts.
groups.quote: The latest update has totally ruined it, can’t see any of my invoicing or create a new one, the buttons don’t work/show.

groups.name: Receipt uploads are broken
groups.description: Reviewers say receipt capture and uploading have become buggy, slow, or unreliable, often preventing them from attaching receipts to expenses or transactions.
groups.quote: Suddenly can’t upload pics of receipts.

groups.name: Rising prices and invoice limits
groups.description: Reviewers object to steep subscription price increases and new monthly invoice caps that force them to pay more.
groups.quote: Have used this app for the past few years, with price increases every year and locking certain features. Now they are limiting the number of invoices you can even send per month.

groups.name: Repeated price increases drive users away
groups.description: Reviewers say recurring price increases have made the apps too expensive, prompting some to consider switching or canceling.
groups.quote: But price keep increasing every year. Last year it was $89 this year $99 and it started at $60 aprox per year. No longer rentable for me.

groups.name: Mobile app is unreliable and limited
groups.description: Reviewers find the mobile app less dependable or capable than the web or desktop version, citing bugs, lost entries, slow syncing, extra steps, and missing features.
groups.quote: App misses time entries and has lag on updates

groups.name: Mileage tracking does not work
groups.description: Reviewers report that mileage tracking is unreliable, stops working, or fails to record trips for extended periods.
groups.quote: the mileage tracking is completely broken
